reason: A read-only policy and configuration drift evidence tool that compares pinned and observed snapshots, classifies changes, and optionally publishes a content-addressed JSON report without returning policy values.

summaries.zh: 用于比较固定基线与观测到的策略快照、分类配置漂移并生成内容寻址证据报告的工具。
summaries.en: A tool for comparing pinned and observed policy snapshots, classifying configuration drift, and producing content-addressed evidence reports.

capabilities: Reads supplied policy manifests and snapshots for comparison
Computes SHA-256 digests and classifies policy drift
Writes one content-addressed JSON evidence report under an explicit artifact directory
Exposes CLI, DeepSeek Harness, and stdio MCP interfaces
